understood.text:
fix(responses): keep gpt-5.4/5.5 tool calls on chat and merge bridged tool calls into one choice

## TLDR

Problem this solves:

- gpt-5.4+ tool calls come back in `choices[1]`, separate from the text
- Clients reading only `choices[0]` (e.g. Google ADK) never see the tool call
- gpt-5.4/5.5 tools requests get sent to the Responses API when they don't need to be

How it solves it:

- Unset `reasoning_effort` on gpt-5.4/5.5 stays on Chat Completions again
- The unset-effort bridge now kicks in only from gpt-5.6, where Chat Completions rejects it
- Bridged responses put the tool calls on the same choice as the text

Intentional product change: for gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 with function tools and no `reasoning_effort` on OpenAI or Azure, the proxy calls `/chat/completions` instead of `/responses`, which is what 1.96.0 did. When a Responses reply has text plus tool calls, the client now gets one choice with `finish_reason: "tool_calls"` where it used to get a `stop` text choice followed by a separate tool-call choice

## User Flow

Before: an agent app sends a tools request through the proxy and the tool call lands in a second choice the app ignores

1. The app sends POST https://litellm-domain/v1/chat/completions with `model: azure/gpt-5.4-mini`, one function tool, and no `reasoning_effort`
2. The response has 2 choices: `choices[0]` holds the text "Let me check the weather." with `finish_reason: "stop"`
3. `choices[1]` holds the `get_weather` call with `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`
4. The app reads only `choices[0]`, sees a finished answer, and never runs the tool

After: the same request returns the text and the tool call together, so the app runs the tool

1. The app sends the same POST https://litellm-domain/v1/chat/completions
2. The response has 1 choice with the text and the `get_weather` call, `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`
3. The app reads `choices[0]`, runs `get_weather`, and continues the conversation; gpt-5.6+ requests (still sent to Responses) come back the same way

## Affected release

Regression in v1.97.0, still present in v1.103.2 and on main

## Screenshots / Proof of Fix

Real OpenAI and Azure calls through a local proxy, with the merge base on port 16764 and the PR head on port 16765. Both configs list `openai/gpt-5.4-mini`, `openai/gpt-5.5`, `openai/gpt-5.6` and `azure/gpt-5.4-nano` (api_version `2025-04-01-preview`). Azure has no gpt-5.4-mini deployment in our test accounts, so gpt-5.4-nano stands in for it. Every case sends the same body, with only the model changing:

```bash
curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $LITELLM_MASTER_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "model": "'$MODEL'",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is the weather in Paris? Say one sentence then call the tool."}],
  "tools": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get the weather for a city.",
    "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"]}}}]
}' | jq -c '[.choices[] | {index, finish_reason, content: .message.content, tools: [.message.tool_calls[]?.function.name]}]'
```

The upstream route column comes from a forwarding recorder sitting between the proxy and the provider

The Playground can't attach an arbitrary function tool, so the UI check uses the Logs page for the same curl requests against openai/gpt-5.4-mini

fix(responses): keep gpt-5.4/5.5 tool calls on chat and merge bridged tool calls into one choice

## TLDR

Problem this solves:

- gpt-5.4+ tool calls come back in `choices[1]`, separate from the text
- Clients reading only `choices[0]` (e.g. Google ADK) never see the tool call
- gpt-5.4/5.5 tools requests get sent to the Responses API when they don't need to be

How it solves it:

- Unset `reasoning_effort` on gpt-5.4/5.5 stays on Chat Completions again
- The unset-effort bridge now kicks in only from gpt-5.6, where Chat Completions rejects it
- Bridged responses put the tool calls on the same choice as the text

Intentional product change: for gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 with function tools and no `reasoning_effort` on OpenAI or Azure, the proxy calls `/chat/completions` instead of `/responses`, which is what 1.96.0 did. When a Responses reply has text plus tool calls, the client now gets one choice with `finish_reason: "tool_calls"` where it used to get a `stop` text choice followed by a separate tool-call choice

## User Flow

Before: an agent app sends a tools request through the proxy and the tool call lands in a second choice the app ignores

1. The app sends POST https://litellm-domain/v1/chat/completions with `model: azure/gpt-5.4-mini`, one function tool, and no `reasoning_effort`
2. The response has 2 choices: `choices[0]` holds the text "Let me check the weather." with `finish_reason: "stop"`
3. `choices[1]` holds the `get_weather` call with `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`
4. The app reads only `choices[0]`, sees a finished answer, and never runs the tool

After: the same request returns the text and the tool call together, so the app runs the tool

1. The app sends the same POST https://litellm-domain/v1/chat/completions
2. The response has 1 choice with the text and the `get_weather` call, `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`
3. The app reads `choices[0]`, runs `get_weather`, and continues the conversation; gpt-5.6+ requests (still sent to Responses) come back the same way

## Affected release

Regression in v1.97.0, still present in v1.103.2 and on main

Resolves LIT-9182
